concepts.gloss_en: "Luminaries of light" — the supernal lights (aspect of Shabbat), counterpart to מאורי אש

members.note: bare construct phrase naming the entity itself

concepts.gloss_en: The shining/prevailing of the luminaries of light — the act of these lights illuminating and overpowering, not the lights themselves

members.note: verbal predication (they shine/prevail) about מאורי אור; action ≠ entity per rule 4

concepts.gloss_en: The departure/withdrawal of the luminaries of light — the state of their removal (heaven forbid), opposite of their shining

members.note: construct head הסתלקות (removal) governs מאורי אור; a state/event about the entity, and semantically the inverse of it, so distinct per rule 4

notes: All three share the head מאורי אור but the second and third add distinct action/state heads (shining vs. withdrawal) that are semantic opposites; under-merge preferred. The bare form is kept as its own concept, not as a merge target.
